verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents 'Hosted cloud access from desktop and mobile' and Slack integrations where the agent can be mentioned/replies posted, plus conversation controls (pause/resume, ask_oracle, auto-approve) that hint at oversight mechanisms, but there is no documented mobile-specific approval UI or workflow for a PM to approve key agent decisions while agents continue working. missing for 10: dedicated mobile approval/decision-point UI, evidence of async approve/reject actions surfaced to a non-technical PM, hands-on confirmation the mobile web experience supports this workflow.
